title: When the Atlas Breaks
author: Gideon Ravensworth
blurb: Silas Fairweather, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
